_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gas distribution and midstream signals with ONEOK's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We are the sole general partner and, as of December 31, 2016, owned 41.2 percent of ONEOK Partners (NYSE: OKS), one of the largest publicly traded master limited partnerships.' 'Our cash flow depends heavily on the earnings and distributions of ONEOK Partners.' 'The volatility of natural gas, crude oil and NGL prices could affect adversely ONEOK Partners’ cash flows.' (the FY2016 10-K's own words; it does not use the word cyclical, so DURABLE, the MU rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining': none names gas distribution or midstream), so the watch list is empty; ENERGY_TRANSITION's reserves and refining are out of scope (the TRGP and BKR reading): ONEOK Partners holds no reserves of its own and refines nothing ('ONEOK Partners may rely on estimates of proved reserves in its decision to construct new pipelines and facilities, which may prove to be inaccurate because there are numerous uncertainties inherent in estimating quantities of proved reserves'); its greenhouse gas risk factor: 'ONEOK Partners may face significant costs to comply with the regulation of GHG emissions.' (text only); the 10-K's one cloud sentence is an accounting standard: 'The standard clarifies whether a cloud computing arrangement includes a software license.' (text only)

BEAR.desc: EPS -52.9%/yr (worst year FY07-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +23.6%/yr (Q3 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +23.6%/yr (FY07-FY16 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +45.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY07-FY16, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: OKE (retrospective, 2017-12-29) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 1.02x (90.6% downside to Bear $5 / +89.0% upside to Bull $101) | Adj composite 2.28 vs market 1.87: gap +0.41 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +19% above the EPP floor $45 (24x FY17E $1.86) | Conservative 2-yr case: +66.3% total (+33.2%/yr) | At 28.7x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $71 sits at or below the BASE case; net margin +11.7% and Distribution operating income n/r in Q3 2017, forward revenues +23.3% (no FY17 revenue guide in numbers, Q3 2017 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (CLOUD and OFFSHORE are scoped to IT, ECOMMERCE to retail, STREAMING to TV, ENERGY_TRANSITION to reserves and refining).
